## What this category is for
This category provides tools for three main areas:
1. **Consumer shopping** (Amazon): Browse products, manage carts/wishlists, place orders, and post reviews.
2. **Travel booking** (Expedia): Search and book flights/accommodations, manage reservations.
3. **Store management** (Shopify): Create/update products, manage orders, analyze store performance.

## When to use this category
Use when the user wants to:
- Shop online or manage an existing shopping cart/wishlist
- Book travel (flights, hotels) or manage travel reservations
- Operate an online store (add products, process orders, view analytics)

## Mandatory workflow

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.page_content_preview:
Loaded with fresh blueberries, these tender scones have a hint of lemon zest and a buttery crumb. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. 

Preparation time: 15 minutes | Baking time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8 

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions: 
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry, mixing just until dough comes together.
7. Turn dough onto floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges, place on parchment-lined baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with cream, sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
10. Bake for 16–18 minutes until golden brown.

Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

This category provides tools to interact with smart home devices (like August Smart Locks, Google Home), surveillance systems, and IoT automation platforms (like IFTTT). Use these tools to control devices, manage access, automate tasks, and retrieve status information.

## When to use this category
- You need to control physical devices (locks, lights, thermostats, media players)
- You want to automate tasks between different services or devices
- You need to manage access permissions for smart locks
- You want to query device status or access history
- You need to set reminders or play media through smart speakers

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

arguments.content:
## What this category is for
This category enables cryptocurrency trading on exchanges like Binance and blockchain operations on platforms like Ethereum. It handles trading orders, account management, fiat deposits/withdrawals, price queries, and smart contract development/deployment.

## When to use this category
Use when the user wants to:
- Trade cryptocurrencies (buy/sell)
- Manage exchange accounts (deposit/withdraw funds, check balances)
- Query market data or transaction history
- Develop, deploy, or interact with Ethereum smart contracts
- Transfer Ether or query blockchain data

## Mandatory workflow
1. Read this big skill to understand category scope
2. Read the relevant small skill for the specific tool before calling
3. Verify all required parameters are collected
4. Execute tool call

## Child Skill Index
Read this big skill first, then read the matching child skill below before tool calls.

### **Perfect Blueberry Scones**
**Ingredients:**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour

*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
*   1 cup fresh blueberries
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1.  **Prep:** Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  **Dry Ingredients:** Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  **Butter:** Cut in cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
4.  **Fruit:** Gently fold in the blueberries.
5.  **Wet Ingredients:** In another bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla.
6.  **Combine:** Stir wet ingredients into dry until just combined.
7.  **Shape:** Pat dough into a 1-inch thick circle on a floured surface.
8.  **Cut:** Slice into 8 wedges and move to the baking sheet.
9.  **Bake:** Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. **Cool:** Let them cool on a wire rack before serving.

**Tip:** For extra sweetness, brush with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Enjoy!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

### **Perfect Blueberry Scones**
**Prep time:** 15 mins | **Bake time:** 18-22 mins | **Yield:** 8 scones

#### **Ingredients**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/3 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
*   1 cup fresh blueberries
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract

#### **Instructions**
1.  **Prep:** Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  **Dry Ingredients:** Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  **Butter:** Cut in cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
4.  **Fruit:** Gently fold in the blueberries.
5.  **Wet Ingredients:** In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla.
6.  **Combine:** Stir wet ingredients into dry until just combined.
7.  **Shape:** On a floured surface, pat dough into a 1-inch thick circle.
8.  **Cut:** Slice into 8 wedges and move to the baking sheet.
9.  **Bake:** Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. **Serve:** Cool on a wire rack. Best served warm!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

This category enables applications to interact with social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter) for posting content, managing profiles, engaging with others, and searching information.

Use these tools when the user needs to:
- Create, read, update, or delete social media posts
- Manage user profiles and settings
- Send messages or engage with other users (comments, likes, follows)

- Perform batch operations (delete multiple tweets, follow multiple users)

### **Perfect Blueberry Scones**
**Ingredients:**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/3 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
*   1 cup fresh blueberries
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1.  **Prep:** Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  **Dry Ingredients:** Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  **Butter:** Cut in cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
4.  **Fruit:** Gently fold in the blueberries.
5.  **Wet Ingredients:** In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla.
6.  **Combine:** Stir wet ingredients into dry until just combined.
7.  **Shape:** Pat dough into a 1-inch thick circle on a floured surface.
8.  **Cut:** Slice into 8 wedges and place on the baking sheet.
9.  **Bake:** Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. **Cool:** Let them cool on a wire rack before serving.

**Tip:** For extra sweetness, brush with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.

data.page_content_preview:
Loaded with fresh blueberries, these tender scones have a hint of lemon zest and a buttery crumb. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. 

Preparation time: 15 minutes | Baking time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8 

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions: 
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry, mixing just until dough comes together.
7. Turn dough onto floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges, place on parchment-lined baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with cream, sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
10. Bake for 16–18 minutes until golden brown.

Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

## What this category is for
This category enables interaction with healthcare services (like Teladoc), clinical record systems (like EpicFHIR), and genetic data platforms (like 23andMe). Use it to access medical records, manage appointments, consult doctors, handle prescriptions, and work with genetic data including insights, sharing, and privacy settings.

## How to decide when to use this category
Use this category when the user request involves:
- Healthcare services: appointments, consultations, prescriptions, medical history, doctor reviews.
- Clinical records: downloading files, updating patient records, or managing clinical documents in an EHR.
- Genetic data: retrieving, analyzing, sharing, or managing privacy of genetic information.
- Health data integration: accessing or updating personal health records.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

## What this category is for
This category provides tools for three main areas:
1. **Consumer shopping** (Amazon): Browse products, manage carts/wishlists, place orders, and post reviews.
2. **Travel booking** (Expedia): Search and book flights/accommodations, manage reservations.
3. **Store management** (Shopify): Create/update products, manage orders, analyze store performance.

## When to use this category
Use when the user wants to:
- Shop online or manage an existing shopping cart/wishlist
- Book travel (flights, hotels) or manage travel reservations
- Operate an online store (add products, process orders, view analytics)
